combo.oracle: literal longest secret prefix that occurs as substring

seats.oracle: bbox area == cardinality for each label prefix; no corner criterion used by oracle

werewolf.oracle: direct two-form BFS versus two activation trees + Euler rectangles + independent Fenwick sweep

doll.oracle: literal toggle state machine until first origin return; exact trigger sequence and every final switch checked

highway.oracle: Dijkstra on each actual queried A/B weighting; answer pair checked, no shortest-path-tree assumption in oracle

meetings.oracle: enumerate every meeting site and every participant, take literal intervening maximum; vector DP and one-cross inequality checked
